Let's plan.

connectors.name: OpenLayers MCP

tools.name: getCapabilities
tools.description: Get the connected map projection, actual commands, source formats and loading constraints.

tools.name: flyTo
tools.description: Animate to WGS84 longitude/latitude; returns the view after animation finishes.

tools.name: setView
tools.description: Set view instantly using WGS84 longitude/latitude.

tools.name: getView
tools.description: Get the actual view in WGS84 and its projection.

tools.name: fitExtent
tools.description: Fit a WGS84 bounding box; west must be below east and south below north.

tools.name: zoomIn
tools.description: Animate one zoom level in and return the resulting view.

tools.name: zoomOut
tools.description: Animate one zoom level out and return the resulting view.

tools.name: addTileLayer
tools.description: Add OSM, XYZ/TMS, WMS, or WMTS. WMTS requires a GetCapabilities URL and a layer name. Invalid sources fail rather than falling back to OSM. 已在 GeoD 配置的图源优先使用 loadSource。

url.description: Browser-readable URL. The host supplies local file URLs; raw filesystem paths are not supported.

tileUrl.description: Optional WMTS REST tile template override, e.g. a working mirror from GetCapabilities.

tools.name: addVectorLayer
tools.description: Read inline data or a URL as GeoJSON, KML, GPX, TopoJSON or WKT. A WFS GetFeature URL with GeoJSON output can be used. Returns actual feature count.

url.description: Browser-readable URL. The host supplies local file URLs; raw filesystem paths are not supported.

tools.name: addVectorTileLayer
tools.description: Add an MVT vector tile layer from a {z}/{x}/{y} URL template.

url.description: Browser-readable URL. The host supplies local file URLs; raw filesystem paths are not supported.

tools.name: getLayer
tools.description: Inspect layer type, source type, state, extent and feature count.

tools.name: fitLayer
tools.description: Fit the actual vector or raster extent of a layer.

tools.name: removeLayer
tools.description: Remove a layer and dispose resources owned by the bridge.

tools.name: listLayers
tools.description: List stable layer IDs, source types, loading states and properties.

tools.name: setLayerVisibility
tools.description: Show or hide a layer.

tools.name: setLayerOpacity
tools.description: Set layer opacity from 0 to 1.

tools.name: setLayerZIndex
tools.description: Set layer stacking order.

tools.name: addGeoTIFFLayer
tools.description: Load GeoTIFF/COG via a browser-readable URL, using actual raster pixels. Supports selected bands and nodata. Returns metadata readiness separately from rendered tile state. Host must expose local files via an HTTP Range or custom protocol URL.

url.description: Browser-readable URL. The host supplies local file URLs; raw filesystem paths are not supported.

tools.name: addImageLayer
tools.description: Add a static georeferenced image, image WMS, or ArcGIS MapServer/ImageServer export image.

url.description: Browser-readable URL. The host supplies local file URLs; raw filesystem paths are not supported.

extent.description: Static image extent in the specified projection, default EPSG:4326.

tools.name: addFeature
tools.description: Add geometry in the supplied data projection (default WGS84). Circle radius uses map projection units.

tools.name: addGeoJSON
tools.description: Add inline or URL GeoJSON to an existing or default vector layer.

url.description: Browser-readable URL. The host supplies local file URLs; raw filesystem paths are not supported.

tools.name: removeFeature
tools.description: Remove a feature by ID.

tools.name: updateFeature
tools.description: Update feature coordinates, properties or style. Coordinates use dataProjection, default WGS84.

tools.name: listFeatures
tools.description: List JSON-safe feature information with offset/limit pagination, without OpenLayers geometry objects.

tools.name: exportFeatures
tools.description: Export loaded vector features as GeoJSON in a target projection, default WGS84. Circles are converted to polygons.

tools.name: clearFeatures
tools.description: Clear all features from a vector layer.

tools.name: getFeaturesInExtent
tools.description: Query loaded vector features whose geometries intersect a WGS84 box.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Composite all visible map canvases into a PNG. CORS-tainted tiles cause an explicit error. HTML controls/overlays are not included.

tools.name: getFeatureAtPixel
tools.description: Pick a rendered feature at CSS pixel coordinates with optional layer filter.

tools.name: addOverlay
tools.description: Add a sanitized HTML overlay at WGS84 coordinates.

tools.name: removeOverlay
tools.description: Remove an overlay.

tools.name: updateOverlay
tools.description: Update sanitized overlay content or position.

connectors.name: 数据范围 · 文件 / 在线 / PostGIS

tools.name: data_connections_list
tools.description: List saved PostgreSQL/PostGIS connections by ID and name; no credentials. Use data_connection_connect to create a connection from the conversation.

tools.name: data_connection_connect
tools.description: Connect to PostgreSQL/PostGIS, test access, save a connection and discover actual tables and spatial layers. Supply a user-provided workspace-relative credentialFile (JSON with host, port, database, user, password, sslMode, optional name), or host/database/user with optional name/port/sslMode. A required password opens native authentication and the tool waits for completion; never ask for passwords in chat or read the credential file through shell tools. Returns a stable connection ID and actual tables and layers. Reuse existing connections when appropriate.

tools.name: data_layer_inspect
tools.description: Read a PostgreSQL table or PostGIS layer's actual field names/types, feature count and sample attribute records. Use a returned table ID (schema.table) or spatial layer ID (schema.table.geometry_column). Works for points, lines and polygons; does not attach a clipping boundary. Geometry remains native. Count over 10,000 is explicitly a lower bound; sample records are not the full dataset. Use data_input_read to attach a polygon layer as the planning range.

tools.name: data_input_read
tools.description: Read and attach polygon boundaries from one source: supplied HTTP(S) vector data / WFS GetFeature / ArcGIS query / OGC API items URL, a workspace relative vector file, saved PostGIS connectionId, or returned handle. Supports GeoJSON, Shapefile / ZIP, GPKG/SQLite, KML/KMZ, GML, FGB, WKT, CSV WKT. Returns layers to choose with layer + handle/connectionId. Missing CRS needs known sourceCrs, never guess. Geometry stays on desktop. Success attaches boundary to plan_imagery.
